resources.description: One row per district per weekly snapshot

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: Day NJDG was read, in India

fields.name: id
fields.description: State or UT slug and district slug, from the names NJDG prints

fields.name: state
fields.description: State or UT slug

fields.name: district
fields.description: District as NJDG names it. These are court districts, which can differ from revenue districts

fields.name: njdg_code
fields.description: NJDG's State code and district code

fields.name: pending
fields.description: Pending cases, civil and criminal together

fields.name: pending_civil
fields.description: Pending civil cases, the sum of the civil age bands

fields.name: pending_criminal
fields.description: Pending criminal cases, the sum of the criminal age bands

fields.name: older_than_10
fields.description: Pending cases filed more than 10 years ago: the sum of the three oldest age bands, civil and criminal

resources.name: district-measures
resources.description: Weekly detail, one row per district, case kind and figure

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: Day NJDG was read, in India

fields.name: id
fields.description: State or UT slug and district slug, from the names NJDG prints

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Civil or criminal cases

fields.name: measure
fields.description: age_band, case_group, stage, filing_year, case_type and purpose count pending cases; filed and disposed count cases in a year

fields.name: label
fields.description: Age band, case group, stage, case type or purpose as NJDG labels it, or the year for filed, disposed and filing_year. Empty where NJDG gave no label. A case type or purpose label can repeat when NJDG lists it twice

fields.name: cases
fields.description: Number of cases. Empty where NJDG returned no figure

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: Day NJDG was read, in India

fields.name: run
fields.description: daily reads each district's dashboard page; weekly reads the full civil and criminal detail

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: When the run started, UTC

fields.name: finished_at
fields.description: When the run ended, UTC

fields.name: requests
fields.description: Requests sent to NJDG in this run. Pages already saved earlier that day are not requested again

fields.name: rows
fields.description: District rows written

fields.name: gaps
fields.description: Districts with no row from this run

fields.name: status
fields.description: failed means nothing from this run was written

fields.name: note
fields.description: What failed, or what changed in NJDG's district list
